description: This file provides utility functions for manipulating DataPipe graphs in PyTorch, including applying sharding, shuffle settings, and random seeds to data processing pipelines within the torch.utils.data module.

methods.name: list[DataPipe] get_all_graph_pipes(graph: DataPipeGraph)
methods.description: Returns a list of all DataPipe instances within the provided DataPipeGraph.

methods.name: list[DataPipe] _get_all_graph_pipes_helper( graph: DataPipeGraph, id_cache: set[int] )
methods.description: Helper function that recursively traverses the DataPipeGraph to collect all DataPipe instances, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: bool _is_sharding_datapipe(datapipe: DataPipe)
methods.description: Checks if a DataPipe instance supports sharding, by type or presence of method.

methods.name: DataPipe apply_sharding( datapipe: DataPipe, num_of_instances: int, instance_id: int, sharding_group=SHARDING_PRIORITIES.DEFAULT, )
methods.description: Applies sharding to a DataPipe by recursively traversing its graph and invoking 'apply_sharding' on eligible DataPipes.

methods.name: bool _is_shuffle_datapipe(datapipe: DataPipe)
methods.description: Checks if a DataPipe supports shuffle operations based on presence of specific methods.

methods.name: DataPipe apply_shuffle_settings(datapipe: DataPipe, shuffle: bool | None = None)
methods.description: Recursively sets shuffle settings on a DataPipe graph, adding a shuffler if needed.

methods.name: DataPipe apply_shuffle_seed(datapipe: DataPipe, rng: Any)
methods.description: Deprecated: sets the seed for random DataPipes using a specified RNG.

methods.name: bool _is_random_datapipe(datapipe: DataPipe)
methods.description: Checks if a DataPipe supports setting a random seed.

methods.name: DataPipe apply_random_seed(datapipe: DataPipe, rng: torch.Generator)
methods.description: Recursively sets the random seed for DataPipes that support it, based on a provided generator.

ctags.name: apply_sharding
ctags.signature: ( datapipe: DataPipe, num_of_instances: int, instance_id: int, sharding_group=SHARDING_PRIORITIES.DEFAULT, )

ctags.name: apply_shuffle_settings
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_shuffle_settings(datapipe: DataPipe, shuffle: bool | None = None) -> DataPipe:$/
